info.title: x402-negotiator
info.description: Agent-to-agent price negotiation as signed, hash-linked instruments. Three paid moves — offer, counter, accept — each returning its artifact in the 200 body. Paid routes respond 402 with a dual-rail x402 challenge (USDC on Base and USDC on Solana) until an X-PAYMENT header settles on either rail.
info.x-guidance: Agent-to-agent price negotiation instruments — signed offers, counters, and agreements, each returned in-response. Every paid route answers an unpaid request with HTTP 402 and a list of accepted payments (USDC on Base or Solana — pick either), then returns the purchased artifact in the body of the same request once you retry with an X-PAYMENT header. Payment and delivery happen in one round trip; nothing is promised for later. POST /offers ($0.001) returns signed offer instrument POST /counter/:offerId ($0.001) returns signed counter POST /accept/:offerId ($0.001) returns signed agreement with settlement terms

200.description: Signed offer instrument, thread record, and counter/accept links.

instrument.description: A signed negotiation instrument. `payload.prevSignature` and `payload.prevHash` link it to the previous instrument in the thread, forming a verifiable chain.

prevHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the previous payload.

concession.description: Movement analysis. Null on the opening offer.

settlement.description: Agreements only. What is owed, by whom, on which rails, by when.

payment.description: Settlement receipt for this call — same content as X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

502.description: Facilitator unreachable or settlement error — nothing was charged.

PaymentRequirements.description: x402 payment requirements returned with HTTP 402. `accepts` always carries BOTH rails — USDC on Base (EVM) and USDC on Solana — at the same price; the client picks one and names it in the `network` field of its X-PAYMENT payload.

accepts.description: One entry per accepted payment rail.

extra.description: EVM: EIP-712 domain (name/version). Solana: {name, decimals, feePayer} — feePayer sponsors the SOL network fee so the buyer needs only USDC.
